title: verifyDeploymentSnapshot
responsibility: Captures the destination receipt and validates predecessor proof and forward-only commit ancestry.

inputs.name: captureDeploymentTarget.reviewed
inputs.description: Reviewed deployment plan with repository, target, configuration hash and predecessor receipt.

inputs.name: captureDeploymentTarget.plugin
inputs.description: Deployment adapter used to discover configured target identities.

inputs.name: verifyDeploymentSnapshot.root
inputs.description: Absolute Git repository directory whose source and deployment receipts are inspected.

inputs.name: verifyDeploymentSnapshot.reviewed
inputs.description: Reviewed deployment plan with repository, target, configuration hash and predecessor receipt.

inputs.name: verifyDeploymentSnapshot.guard
inputs.description: Reviewed configuration or destination proof that must still match before the next step.

outputs.name: captureDeploymentTarget
outputs.description: Configured target and captured destination receipt, or an admission error.

outputs.name: verifyDeploymentSnapshot
outputs.description: Resolves only while the source, mapping and captured destination remain valid.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unsafe source, target or promotion state; no successful deployment receipt is recorded.
